name: Groupe Samsic (Samsic SAS, holding)
note: French services group founded in 1986 by Christian Roulleau; the company register shows SAMSIC, SIREN 403227796, a SAS based in Cesson-Sévigné with Thierry Geffroy as président. The group's own site says it is and will remain a family-owned business (samsic-family-ownership).
